SASBDB entry SASDPP2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDPP2/)

Apo Pyrococcus furiosus Argonaute (monomer, 91.3 kDa) in 20 mM Tris-HCl, 250 mM NaCl, 2 mM DTT,
6 M urea, pH 8.0, 37 C; SSRF BL19U2, 0.25 mg/ml. No publication is listed by SASBDB.
Files, all from SASBDB (https://www.sasbdb.org/rest-api/entry/summary/SASDPP2/) except 1Z26.pdb:
  experimental_data/SASDPP2.dat    media/intensities_files/SASDPP2.dat (q in A^-1)
  SASDPP2_fit1.fit                 media/fitting_files/SASDPP2_fit1.fit (CRYSOL, q in A^-1)
  SASDPP2_fit1_model1.pdb          media/pdb_file/SASDPP2_fit1_model1.pdb (atomic; SASBDB states
                                   it is identical to PDB 1Z26, but it is a hydrogenated
                                   frame: 12 645 atoms, 6399 H, residues 18-770, no chain id)
  1Z26.pdb                         RCSB crystal structure (5951 ATOM, chain A, 155 HETATM, no H),
                                   kept for comparison, not used by the script.
SASDPP2 has one fit, CRYSOL (chi2 2.753, header and REST agree). The model already has its
hydrogens, so the script sets addHydrogens = false.
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDPP2/ states the conditions it takes from the entry;
the paper was not consulted (there is none).
